info.title: Áskell API V2
info.description:
# Authentication
Authentication is via `Authorization` header. When using this documentation to test the API you should prepend your given api key with `"Api-Key "`. 

You are given two types of API keys, one public and one secret. Your public key is safe to use in javascript so that it is public to the world. It can only 
be used to generate a temporary payment method, which in turn has to be confirmed using your secret api key.

See [the documentation](https://docs.askell.is/) for more information.

get.description: Lists catalog products for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.
Returns a catalog product and its prices for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.
Lists catalog prices for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.
Returns a catalog price for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.
Lists bundle templates for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.
Returns a bundle template and its selectable item prices for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Discover V2 bundle add-ons
post.description: Returns product and bundle add-ons available for a selected bundle configuration. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Quote a V2 subscription offer
post.description: Compiles a bundle or direct catalog item offer without creating a contract. Recurring quote lines reflect first-period start proration when the offer begins between anchor dates. Requires a secret key.

get.description: Lists active verified payment methods for a customer identified by customer reference. Canceled methods are omitted from the list. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Create or replace a V2 customer payment method
post.description: Creates a card payment method or creates/replaces the active claim or invoice setup for the selected account payment processor. The account payment processor is always explicit. Card imports create a new row and cancel conflicting active card methods; claim and invoice creation replaces only the matching active setup. Requires a secret key.

get.summary: Get a V2 customer payment method
get.description: Returns a sanitized payment method by id for the customer, including canceled methods. Token data is never returned. Requires a secret key.

patch.summary: Update a V2 customer payment method
patch.description: Partially updates mutable setup fields for an active payment method. Metadata is shallow-merged and null values remove metadata keys. The collection method and account payment processor are immutable; create a new payment method to change them. Requires a secret key.

delete.summary: Cancel a V2 customer payment method
delete.description: Soft-cancels the payment method, clears stored setup data, and returns 204. Repeating the delete for an already canceled method is idempotent. Requires a secret key.

get.description: Returns current or time-specific service entitlement state for a customer, optionally filtered by catalog product reference. Requires a secret key. Use `service_active` as the integration-facing access flag; do not infer access from payment state.

parameters.name: product_reference
parameters.description: Optional catalog product reference. When omitted, all current entitlements for the customer are returned.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Optional evaluation timestamp. Defaults to the current server time.

get.description: Lists subscription contracts for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Create a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Creates a subscription contract from either a bundle template or direct recurring catalog prices. Use `initial_billing_mode` to choose first-period billing behavior: `none` creates only the recurring schedules, `create_initial_run` creates a scheduled initial BillingRun, and `next_invoice` defers first-period recurring proration lines to the first scheduled invoice. Initial one-time items require `initial_billing_mode=create_initial_run`. Requires a secret key.

get.description: Returns a subscription contract for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.

patch.summary: Partially update a V2 subscription contract
patch.description: Restricted patch endpoint. Only `metadata` and `payment_processor_override` may be updated. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Preview a V2 subscription contract proration
post.description: Previews the proration impact of updating an existing V2 subscription contract item. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Update a V2 subscription contract item with proration
post.description: Executes a prorated update for an existing V2 subscription contract item. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Add a V2 subscription contract item with proration
post.description: Executes a prorated add-item change for an existing V2 subscription contract. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Remove a V2 subscription contract item with proration
post.description: Executes a prorated remove-item change for an existing V2 subscription contract. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Cancel a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Cancels a V2 subscription contract immediately or schedules cancellation at the end of the current billing cycle. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Restart renewals for a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Clears a pending period-end cancellation or reactivates a canceled V2 subscription contract. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Pause renewals for a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Creates a finite pause window for a V2 subscription contract. Current pauses move the contract to paused and future pauses are scheduled. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Resume renewals for a paused V2 subscription contract
post.description: Cancels the current pause and resumes renewals for a paused V2 subscription contract. Requires a secret key.

delete.summary: Delete a future V2 subscription contract pause
delete.description: Soft-cancels a future scheduled pause for a V2 subscription contract. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Activate a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Transitions an inactive V2 subscription contract to active. Use the resume endpoint for paused contracts. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Apply a promotion code to a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Validates and redeems a promotion code for the contract, creating an active discount that is applied to subsequent billing runs. A contract can only carry one active discount at a time. Requires a secret key.

get.summary: Get the active discount for a V2 subscription contract
get.description: Returns the contract's active coupon discount, or null when none is active. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Remove the active discount from a V2 subscription contract
post.description: Ends the contract's active coupon discount. Subsequent billing runs are charged at full price. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Create a V2 hosted checkout
post.description: Creates a pending hosted checkout from either a bundle template or direct catalog prices, returning a token, checkout URL, and quote snapshot. An explicit account payment processor can be supplied when more than one compatible processor is configured. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Discover eligible V2 payment processors
post.description: Compiles the requested V2 offer and returns the eligible account payment processors for the resolved currency and collection method. Use this before checkout creation when the client must choose between multiple compatible processors. Requires a secret key.

get.description: Returns a pending or finalized V2 checkout for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Create a hosted V2 payment method registration
post.description: Creates a checkout-bound hosted payment method registration session for the checkout's selected account payment processor. The response contains a public hosted card-form URL and private status URL. Requires a secret key.

get.summary: Get a V2 payment method registration
get.description: Returns the status of a checkout-bound payment method registration and confirms a verified payment method when the processor has completed tokenization. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Finalize a V2 checkout
post.description: Creates the subscription contract and initial billing run, then executes payment. The contract is activated only after successful payment. An offer with recurring items requires a verified payment method for the customer even when the initial total is zero (trial period or fully discounted first period); the card is charged when the first paid period arrives. Only a free one-time purchase finalizes without one. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Create an embedded checkout session
post.description: Creates a short-lived checkout session from a sales channel. The seller backend calls this endpoint with a secret API key and sends only the returned session token to the browser widget. Sales-channel offer, origin, payment-processor, metadata, theme, and terms policies are snapshotted onto the session.

get.description: Returns private checkout-session state for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.
Returns V2 billing runs for the authenticated account, including lines and attempts. Requires a secret key.
Returns a V2 billing run with lines and attempts for the authenticated account. Requires a secret key.

post.summary: Retry a V2 billing run
post.description: Schedules a manual retry for a retryable V2 billing run. A reason is required and is recorded in billing-run metadata. Requires a secret key.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account's fulfillment orders, newest first, with the same body the `fulfillment_order.*` webhooks carry. Intended for backfill and for polling-based reconciliation after a missed webhook delivery. Read-only. Requires a secret key, that the account uses subscription contracts, and that shipping is enabled for the account.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only orders changed at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp. A bare date means the start of that day. This is the reconciliation filter: poll it with the `updated_at` of the last order you processed.

parameters.name: created_since
parameters.description: Only orders created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp. A bare date means the start of that day.

get.description: Returns one fulfillment order belonging to the authenticated account, with its lines, delivery address, shipping selection and booked shipments. Orders belonging to another account return `404`. Read-only. Requires a secret key.

example.non_field_errors: Provide exactly one input mode: `bundle_template` or `items`.

V2ContractDiscount.description: An applied coupon discount on a V2 subscription contract.

promotion_code.description: Optional promotion code. When valid, the resulting discount is folded into the offer totals; on contract creation the code is redeemed and a discount is attached to the contract.

customer.description: Optional customer id. When given, the quote also reflects combo discounts earned through the customer's other active contracts, and promotion-code restrictions are checked against this customer.

initial_billing_mode.description: `none` creates recurring schedules without a first-period billing artifact. `create_initial_run` creates a scheduled initial BillingRun with first-period recurring lines and one-time initial items. `next_invoice` creates pending first-period recurring proration lines for the first scheduled invoice.

V2SubscriptionContractProrationPreview.description: Polymorphic preview request. Fields beyond the common ones are operation-specific; fields not supported by the selected operation are rejected with a 400 validation error.

price.description: Only applies to add_item and update_item. Required for add_item.

quantity.description: Only applies to add_item and update_item.

discount_percent.description: Only applies to add_item and update_item.

unit_amount_override.description: Fixed per-unit amount for the item, used instead of the catalog price. Only applies to add_item and update_item. On update_item, omitting the field keeps the item's current override while an explicit null clears it so the item reverts to the catalog price.
Fixed per-unit amount for the new item, used instead of the catalog price.
Fixed per-unit amount for the item, used instead of the catalog price. Omitting the field keeps the item's current override; an explicit null clears it so the item reverts to the catalog price.

discount_amount_due_now.description: Contract coupon discount applied to the immediate (invoice_now) charge. Percent-off, non-once coupons only; 0.0000 otherwise.

next_billing_estimate.description: Estimated next recurring charge, net of the contract's active coupon discount.

delivery_address.description: Optional delivery-address snapshot for physical products or alternate delivery.

shipping.description: The shipping option the customer chose. Required when the offer contains physical products and the account has active shipping options.

allowed_origin.description: Origin allowed to embed the hosted card form for this checkout in an iframe, for example `https://shop.example`. A single http(s) origin with no path; http is accepted only for `localhost` and loopback addresses (`127.0.0.0/8`, `[::1]`). When set it replaces the account-level checkout origins in the hosted page's `frame-ancestors` policy. Not accepted on checkout-session endpoints, where the sales channel's allowed origins apply.

option.description: Id of one of the account's active shipping options. An option with a rate table is priced for the delivery address's zip code (the request's `delivery_address`, else the customer's address) and the weight of the goods; when the table has no rate for that delivery the request fails with `400`, `shipping` describing why and `shipping_code` `shipping_not_available`.

location_id.description: Provider id of the chosen pickup location. Required for options with `requires_location`.

V2ShippingSelection.description: Snapshot of the shipping option chosen at checkout.

zone_name.description: The shipping zone that priced the selection, or an empty string when the option is flat-priced or the rate applied to every zip code.

weight_band.description: The weight band that priced the selection as `min-max` in grams (`max` empty for an open-ended band), or an empty string for a flat-priced option.

V2PickupLocation.description: The chosen pickup location as a structured block an external fulfillment system can book against, or null when the selection has none (home delivery, freight, store pickup without an address). Derived from the shipping provider's own payload, with the flat `location_*` values as the fallback.

id.description: The provider's id for the location.

address.description: One-line address, composed from street, zip code and town when the provider does not supply one.

external_id.description: The location's id in the provider's upstream system, when it exposes one.

city.description: Required by the embedded checkout widget for non-Icelandic addresses. Icelandic addresses resolve city from `zip_code`.

sales_channel.description: Sales channel id or account-scoped reference.

customer.description: Existing customer id. Provide only one of `customer` or `customer_reference`.

customer_reference.description: Seller customer reference. If an existing customer has this reference, the session is bound to that customer.

theme.description: Optional checkout theme override for this session.

terms_url.description: Optional per-session terms URL. Sales-channel terms are used when omitted.

terms_required.description: Requires buyer acceptance for this session. A provided `terms_url` also makes acceptance required.

account_payment_processor.description: Account payment processor id. Required for all collection methods.

token.description: Required for direct card imports. Never returned by the API.

valid_until.description: Card expiry timestamp. For card imports, provide this or expiration_month plus expiration_year.

payor_id.description: Claim payor kennitala. Defaults from customer_reference when omitted and valid.

external_customer_reference.description: Invoice-system customer reference. Defaults from customer_reference when omitted.

invoice_email.description: Invoice delivery email. Defaults from the customer email when omitted.

metadata.description: Shallow-merged into existing client metadata. A null value removes that metadata key.

allowed_origin.description: Origin allowed to embed this hosted card form in an iframe, for example `https://shop.example`. A single http(s) origin with no path; http is accepted only for `localhost` and loopback addresses (`127.0.0.0/8`, `[::1]`). Defaults to the checkout's `allowed_origin`, and when set it replaces the account-level checkout origins in the hosted page's `frame-ancestors` policy. Not accepted on checkout-session endpoints, where the sales channel's allowed origins apply.
Origin allowed to embed this hosted card form, or an empty string when the account-level checkout origins apply.

shipping_fee.description: Sendingargjald sem er hluti af checkout-samtölunum, eða null.

allowed_origin.description: Origin allowed to embed hosted pages for this checkout, or an empty string when the account-level checkout origins apply.

shipping_fee.description: Sendingargjald sem er hluti af tilboðinu (samtölur innihalda það), eða null.

promotion_code.description: The promotion code applied to this quote, if any. When set, subtotal_amount, tax_amount, and total_amount already include the discount.

discount.description: Discount preview when a promotion code was applied.

skip_trial_period.description: When true, the coupon skipped the offer's trial period: the quoted totals bill the first period immediately.

recurring_original_amount.description: What a renewal bills without the coupon. The recurring_* totals of the quote do not include the promotion code discount.

recurring_discount_amount.description: The coupon's discount applied to a renewal's recurring lines. Computed regardless of duration: a once coupon lapses after the first payment and a repeating coupon after duration_in_months, so only treat this as the renewal discount while the coupon is active.

recurring_final_amount.description: What a renewal bills with the coupon's discount applied. Only meaningful while the coupon is still active (see duration and duration_in_months).

combo_discounts.description: Automatic combo discounts applied to this quote: one entry per discounted recurring line. The quoted totals already include the first-period amounts, and the recurring_* totals already include the renewal amounts. Rules are evaluated against the products in the offer plus, when a customer is given, the products of the customer's other active contracts.

line_key.description: Key of the discounted line in recurring_items.

discount_subtotal_amount.description: First-period (prorated) discount, already reflected in subtotal_amount.

renewal_discount_subtotal_amount.description: Full-period discount applied on each renewal while the customer holds the required products.

V2FulfillmentAddress.description: The delivery address as it stood when the order was created. This is the order's own snapshot, so editing the contract's address afterwards does not change it.

product_reference.description: The seller's own product reference, i.e. the SKU a warehouse picks by. Null when the catalog product has been deleted.

product_name.description: Product name at the time the order was created.

quantity_fulfilled.description: How many units have been included in a shipment.

V2Fulfillment.description: A shipment booked for (part of) an order.

provider_order_id.description: The provider's own identifier for the shipment, such as a Dropp order UUID or a Pósturinn shipment id.

weight_grams.description: Package weight used for the booking.

error.description: The last booking error, empty when the booking succeeded.

V2FulfillmentOrder.description: A physical order generated by a paid billing run. This is also the body of the `fulfillment_order.*` webhooks.

billing_run_id.description: The successful billing run that generated this order. Each run generates at most one order.

fulfillments.description: Shipments booked for this order. Empty until one is booked, and always empty for an account with no shipping providers configured.

estimated_weight_grams.description: Sum of the products' chargeable unit weights, or null when any line lacks weight data, so a partial estimate is never mistaken for a total.

V2EntitlementSummary.description: Aggregate service entitlement state for a subscription contract.

V2CustomerEntitlementItem.description: One contract item considered by the customer entitlement access check.

discount.description: The active coupon discount on this contract, if any.

subscriber_page.description: Absolute URL of the customer-facing subscription management page for this contract.

PageSizeFilter.name: page_size
PageSizeFilter.description: The number of items to return in the response. If omitted, no pagination is applied.

V2ActiveFilter.name: active
V2ActiveFilter.description: Filter active resources. Use `all` or `any` to include active and inactive resources.

V2FulfillmentOrderId.name: fulfillmentOrderId
V2FulfillmentOrderId.description: Fulfillment order id. This is the order's `id`, not its per-account `number`.

V2CustomerReference.name: customerReference
V2CustomerReference.description: Customer reference for the customer within the authenticated account.

V2CustomerEntitlements.description: V2 customer service entitlement access-check result

V2PermissionDenied.description: The account may not use this endpoint, for example because it does not use subscription contracts or does not have shipping enabled
